text.en:
The Punong Barangay is hereby authorized to administer oaths of office within the province or
city where his barangay is located to elective public officials for the purpose of qualifying to the office for
which said officials have been elected.

The Minister of Local Government shall issue the corresponding guidelines for the proper
implementation of this Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: February 20, 1985
